access.notes: Open-source plane-wave DFT code; any recent 6.x or 7.x version is acceptable.
The BEEF-vdW functional is part of the libxc library shipped with Quantum ESPRESSO; the agent should select it in the input file.

resources.name: Ultrasoft pseudopotentials for Ni, Co, C, N, H

access.notes: Standard ultrasoft pseudopotentials from GBRV, SSSP, or Pslibrary; e.g., Ni.pbe-spn-kjpaw_psl.1.0.0.UPF, etc. The agent should obtain them from the Quantum ESPRESSO pseudopotential repository or SSSP library.
